The announcement describes it as procuring shipsets, not repairing or overhauling them.

refute_a.reason: Full text names fiscal 2016 shipbuilding and conversion (Navy) alongside fiscal 2016 other procurement (Navy), so SCN is on the action and intersects SCN BLI 2122; procuring main reduction gear shipsets for DDG 51 class destroyers is new-construction propulsion equipment bought under the class's own line — the non-SCN share is procurement, not O&M sustainment.

refute_b.reason: 'DDG-51' has exactly one owner in the index; the other DDG rows are different names on different lines (OPN 0900 'DDG Modernization (DDG MOD) Program', 0603564N 'DDG-51 Flt III Concept Development', and the DDG 1000 lines), none of which is a rival owner for an option procuring main reduction gear shipsets for the class.

proposals.announcement_evidence: to manufacture and deliver the AN/ARC-210 family of radio equipment
proposals.rationale: The index's only ARC-210 rows sit under BLI 4269, the Unmanned Carrier Aviation Mission Control (UMCS) line, where the radio is a component that system incorporates. This award manufactures up to 550 GEN 6 radios and 1,150 units of ancillary equipment for the Navy, Air Force, Marine Corps, other government agencies and FMS customers — a general-purpose radio production IDIQ, not the UCA mission control system's own work. Reject by design: the name is an item the line merely uses, and attributing a service-wide radio buy to it would be a plain misattribution.

proposals.announcement_evidence: to exercise options for DDG 51 Class lead yard support
proposals.rationale: 'DDG 51 Class' normalizes by hyphen alone to the lexicon row 'DDG-51' for SCN BLI 2122. Every appropriation the announcement names is shipbuilding and conversion (Navy) — fiscal 2018, 2020, 2021 and 2022 SCN — which is the appropriation that funds BLI 2122, and lead yard support is the design and engineering support the shipbuilding line carries for ships under construction. This is distinct from the in-service planning-yard services on record 41, which are O&M-funded.

refute_a.reason: Every one of the seven appropriations obligated is shipbuilding and conversion (Navy), fiscal 2015 through 2022, matching SCN BLI 2122 exactly; lead yard support is the design and engineering the construction line carries for ships being built, distinct from the O&M-funded in-service planning yard services on record 41.

refute_b.reason: 'DDG-51' is owned only by SCN 2122; 0900 and 0603564N own different strings, and every appropriation the announcement names is shipbuilding and conversion (Navy), so no other index owner can claim this action.

proposals.announcement_evidence: to exercise options for AEGIS development and test sites operation and maintenance at the Combat Systems Engineering Development Site, SPY-1A Test Facility and Naval Systems Computing Center
proposals.rationale: The Combat Systems Engineering Development Site is the land-based engineering site associated with PE 0604307N, and AEGIS is named, so the identity match is genuine. But the announcement's own words describe 'operation and maintenance' of development and test sites, the appropriation is not stated in the record text, and the award combines purchases for five foreign governments totaling over 31% of value. Facility operation and maintenance is not clearly this element's own development work, so the evidence does not meet the standard.

proposals.announcement_evidence: requirements decomposition and development of Block 4 modernization program capabilities in support of the F-35A/B/C aircraft
proposals.rationale: The announcement names 'F-35' verbatim and describes Block 4 modernization capability development — the effort PE 0604840N carries as F-35 C2D2, the continuous capability development and delivery line. The obligated money includes fiscal 2015 research, development, testing and evaluation (Navy, Marine Corps, Air Force), so Navy RDT&E is on the action and matches an RDT&E,N element. The scope, requirements decomposition and development of new and upgraded capabilities against evolving threats, is the modernization line's own work rather than support of the airframe production line.

refute_a.reason: Full text obligates fiscal 2015 RDT&E (Navy, Marine Corps, Air Force) with a Navy share of $6,611,354, matching RDT&E,N PE 0604840N; requirements decomposition and development of Block 4 modernization capabilities is the F-35 continuous-development line's own work, with the F-35A/B/C named as the airframe the capabilities go into.

refute_b.reason: 0604840M carries the identical index row — same name 'The F-35 Joint Strike Fighter (JSF)', same doc 340, same program title 'F-35 C2D2' — and this action obligates FY2015 RDT&E (Navy, Marine Corps, Air Force) for capabilities 'in support of the F-35A/B/C aircraft', so the Marine Corps twin is on the money and is named by the variants; the evidence cannot choose between the two owners.

proposals.announcement_evidence: requirements decomposition and development of Block 4 modernization program capabilities in support of the F-35A/B/C aircraft
proposals.rationale: The Marine Corps F-35 C2D2 element owns the identical name, and the announcement does cite Marine Corps RDT&E among the fiscal 2015 appropriations, so some share of this action plausibly falls here. But the announcement gives no split between the services, and publishing the same announced value against two program elements would double-count it. Recorded as the alternative owner rather than a second link.

proposals.announcement_evidence: to exercise options for Littoral Combat Ship class design support and integrated data and product model environment support
proposals.rationale: Same contract and scope as record 44, one option year later: 'Littoral Combat Ship' appears verbatim, matching the lexicon row for SCN BLI 2127, and the obligated money is fiscal 2023 shipbuilding and conversion (Navy) cost-to-complete funds, the appropriation that funds that line. refute_a.reason: Fiscal 2023 shipbuilding and conversion (Navy) cost-to-complete funds are the only appropriation named, matching SCN BLI 2127; as on record 44 the class design support and integrated data/product model environment are class design agent work inside the LCS construction line, not O&M sustainment.
